hints.title: Column Independence
hints.text: Notice that operations applied to one column have zero effect on other columns.

hints.title: Top-to-Bottom Traversal
hints.text: Traverse each column from top to bottom ensuring each entry exceeds the cell directly above.

hints.title: Greedy Minimum Value
hints.text: If grid[i][j] <= grid[i - 1][j], increase it to grid[i - 1][j] + 1 and accumulate added increments.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass over each grid cell updating values in place.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Increasing entries beyond the necessary minimum creates compounding overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space modifying grid directly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies greedy local minimization down each column.
